plugins.description: Eight skills for landing pages: webanatomy-setup, persona, find-examples, audit-page, research-best-practices, write-page, build-page, moodboard. Read a page as a structure, ground every move in a scored benchmark library, challenge the draft as your real reader, and assemble a shareable wireframe.
